name: onetaskgraph-github-live
//: The GitHub Projects lane's own names, which its tests and the scheduled janitor read. It depends only on onetaskgraph-live; the GitHub Projects plugin names it as a dev-dependency, so editing it selects that plugin and the janitor and nothing of Linear.

bootstrap.//: Uncached: it reaches the network and writes to the shared cargo registry outside the workspace, so no input in the tree describes its result.

format.//: Uncached: it rewrites the tree in place, so replaying a cached result would be a no-op that silently leaves the tree unformatted.

coverage.//: Uncached: cargo-llvm-cov names every raw profile after the workspace, not the crate, so a cache hit would restore a sibling's stale profiles beside its own. workspace:coverage enforces the floor over every crate's run.
